decisions.reason: The client extends random Small Block ticket allocation from no-code mints to invalid-code mints, replacing the narrower no-referral allocation rule.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
also, with the ' Valid referral number' popup:
\- Only already minted NFTs should be valid.

\- The message for a valid code should read: 'Valid referral code! $5 + $500 prize draw ticket to your selected referer.'

\- For an invalid/no code, a message should read: 'No/Invalid referral code! $5 + $500 prize draw ticket to an existing NFT holder at random.'
